resumeText:
Sandeep Reddy | Hyderabad | sandeep.reddy@example.com

SUMMARY
Platform engineering manager with 13 years in infrastructure, DevOps and SRE for payments companies, the last 5 managing platform teams.

EXPERIENCE
Manager - Platform Engineering, Krishna Payments, Hyderabad (2021 - present)
- Manage 12 engineers across SRE, cloud infrastructure and developer platform teams.
- Hired 8 engineers and run interview loops for SRE and DevOps roles.
- Run 40 production EKS clusters on AWS across three regions.
- Moved all AWS infrastructure to Terraform modules with pull request reviews and drift checks.
- Introduced SLOs and error budgets for 30 payment services with their owning teams.
- Run the 24x7 on-call rotation, act as incident commander for P1 outages and chair blameless postmortems.
- Cut monthly AWS spend by 28% with Savings Plans, rightsizing and Spot nodes.
- Launched a Backstage developer portal with golden path templates for new services.
- Rolled out OpenTelemetry tracing and Grafana dashboards across all payment services.

DevOps Lead, Musi Cloud Labs, Hyderabad (2016 - 2021)
- Led a team of 5 DevOps engineers through the move from a data centre to AWS.
- Built Jenkins and GitHub Actions pipelines that deploy 60 microservices several times a day.

Systems Engineer, Banjara Infotech, Hyderabad (2013 - 2016)
- Administered Linux servers and VMware clusters for banking clients.

SKILLS
AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Prometheus, Grafana, Python, Bash

EDUCATION
BTech Electronics and Communication, JNTU Hyderabad, 2013
